data.one_liner: Easily apply tilt parallax hover effects for Flutter with support for light, shadow and gyroscope sensors.
data.what_it_does: Provides customizable tilt and parallax hover effects for Flutter widgets. It simulates light, shadow, and depth while supporting gyroscope sensor input and various user gestures like hover and touch.
use_when: You want to add 3D tilt and parallax hover effects to cards or UI elements.
You need sensor-based tilt reactions using device gyroscopes.
You want simulated light and shadow effects reacting to user input.
avoid_when: You are building a standard flat UI without interactive depth or tilt effects.
You require complex game physics engines rather than simple UI tilt and parallax.
strengths: Supports gyroscope sensors for physical tilt effects.
Includes built-in simulated light and shadow effects.
Customizable parameters and multiple layout configurations.
weaknesses: Simulated light effect is not ideal for Projector containers.
Requires managing breaking changes when migrating major versions.
data.setup_notes: Depends on sensors_plus for gyroscope features; ensure platform setup for sensors if required by sensors_plus.

alternatives.name: animations
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you need pre-canned material motion and standard transition animations instead of interactive tilt and parallax effects.

data.minimal_example:
Tilt(
  child: Container(
    width: 200,
    height: 300,
    color: Colors.blue,
  ),
)
